context: Bordered summary box with Lip Gloss v2

checklist.name: measures_cells
checklist.description: Measures text with `lipgloss.Width` (or `ansi.StringWidth`), not `len`, so the CJK row aligns.

checklist.name: width_includes_frame
checklist.description: Sets `Width(40)` knowing that in v2 width includes padding and border, rather than subtracting the frame from 40.

checklist.name: adaptive_colors
checklist.description: Detects the background (for example `lipgloss.HasDarkBackground(os.Stdin, os.Stdout)`) and picks colors with `lipgloss.LightDark` or equivalent; does not use v1 `AdaptiveColor`.
